# Glassvow

Glassvow (琉璃誓言) is a single-player card game coming soon to iOS (App Store), Android (Google Play), Amazon Appstore and Steam (PC).
《琉璃誓言》（Glassvow）是一款單人卡牌遊戲，即將登陸 iOS（App Store）、Android（Google Play）、Amazon Appstore 及 Steam（PC）。

Developer: EUGNEL LTD
Site: https://glassvow.eugnel.com/
Support: glassvow@eugnel.com
Privacy: hello@eugnel.com
